summary.text: Christopher Bouchat is a Republican member of the Maryland House of Delegates for District 5, covering Frederick and Carroll counties, elected in November 2022 and a member since January 11, 2023. His official page lists him on the Judiciary Committee.

paragraphs.text: Bouchat's official page says he was born in Baltimore in 1967 and graduated from Howard High School in 1985, with a welding certificate from the Howard Vocational-Technical Center.
It says he attended Catonsville Community College and the University of Maryland Baltimore County, and has been founder and chair of Bouchat Industries, Inc. since 1994.
It lists him as a member of the Carroll County Board of County Commissioners from 2018 to 2022.
